description:
Update elements across one or more clips in ONE call (always batch). Items apply in order; partial success ok. clip_index not needed (element_id is project-unique).

- Per item: position/timing fields, and/or type_data with element_type (settable fields: get_element_schema mode 'update'). `defaults` hoists shared keys; `returning` shapes the reply ([] = counts + errors).
- Keyframes: top-level `keyframes` (not in type_data) replaces only the property tracks your entries name; null or [] clears all.
- Component: after add_elements(component_id), set its content with type_data.parameter_values on the returned animation element.
- Interactive (question/results/form): options/fields sent without an id keep the id of the stored one with the same text/label (reorder-safe); the merged result is re-checked (answer key, jumps, logic).
- Text/shape: type_data.clickaction: null removes the click action; a partial one keeps stored wait_for_click/wait_at.
- Grouping: `group: "<name>"` moves into a named group (created on demand), "" back to the clip root. Coordinates unchanged; members render contiguously at the group's slot; a new group takes its first member's slot (scattered members gather at the lowest).

Concurrency: parallel calls are fine on DIFFERENT element ids; the same id → the later is REJECTED ('changed since this edit was based on'), nothing written: re-read and re-apply. Don't overlap with whole-clip/project writes on the same project (update_clips on that clip, structural clip ops, add_audio, update_project).

defaults.description: Values shared by every item, sent once. Item keys win; type_data merges one level; no per-item unset. E.g. {clip_index:1, element_type:'text', type_data:{font_setting:{font:'Inter',weight:'600'}, alignment:'center'}}; items then carry only what differs.

actions.description: Animation elements only: same as type_data.actions (send in one place).

cues.description: Animation elements only: same as type_data.cues (send in one place).

param_tracks.description: Animation elements only: same as type_data.param_tracks (send in one place).

returning.description: Valid returning options: 'ids', 'layout', 'qa', 'qa.codes'. 'geometry' is not an option; use 'layout' for measured placement, or read element dimensions with get_clip. Response shape (like get_clip `select`). Omitted: ids + layout + compact clip audit. 'ids': element_id per item. 'layout': measured text fit (font_size_px, text_width_px, natural_width_px, line_count, fits_width/fits_height/fits; widen to natural_width_px, not text_width_px; `adjusted` when the measured height replaced yours) + placement {y_anchor, top, center, bottom} (compare placement.center with a container's centre). 'qa.codes': audit severity/code/element_ids; 'qa': + message and fix. Always returned: failed items, font_warnings, audit errors ([] → {total, succeeded, failed} + {clip_index, errors: [{code, element_ids}]}). Bleed under a keyframed group = warning (camera_move).

updates.description: Element updates — at least one entry.

actions.description: Animation elements only: same as type_data.actions (send in one place).

clip_index.description: Optional hint; the server finds the clip from element_id (a wrong one is corrected).

cues.description: Animation elements only: same as type_data.cues (send in one place).

max_width_fraction.description: Widest the box may grow, as a fraction of the canvas (0.95)

min_font_scale.description: Smallest font, as a fraction of the current size (0.8)

fit_to_lines.description: Text only. Max line count N, or {lines, ...}. After this item's updates, the server widens (then shrinks the font) so the text wraps to ≤N lines without overlapping neighbours.

group.description: Named group to move into (created if missing); "" = back to clip root; omit = unchanged.

height.description: px (0 ok). Text: the space given; the box follows the measured text (layout.fits_height).

insert_at.description: Move in z-order. `front`/`back`: ends of its current group (or clip), membership unchanged; if it is ALONE in its group they move the GROUP. {before|after: id}: next to that element/group, inside ITS group (move into/out of a group and position in one call). Applied after `group`.

bezier_overrides.description: Per-property bezier when custom-eased properties need different curves, e.g. {"opacity":[.4,0,.6,1]}; keys must be in this entry.

borderRadius.description: Pen stroke (draw with `nodes`) only: rounds every sharp corner, canvas px 0-500 (the type_data `cornerRadius`). Other types key their per-corner radius properties.

drawEndCap.description: Stroke (draw) only: end cap name; HOLDS until the next key, e.g. an arrowhead appearing when a draw-on finishes.

drawFillColor.description: Stroke (draw) only: fill colour #rrggbb[aa] (alpha = fill opacity).

drawStartCap.description: Stroke (draw) only: start cap name; HOLDS until the next key (no blend).

drawStrokeColor.description: Stroke (draw) only: line colour #rrggbb[aa] (alpha = line opacity).

drawStrokeDash.description: Stroke (draw) only: dash length in canvas pixels (a dashed stroke, with drawStrokeGap > 0).

drawStrokeGap.description: Stroke (draw) only: gap between dashes in canvas pixels.

drawStrokeWidth.description: Stroke (draw) only: line width in canvas pixels.

interpolation.description: Easing for every property in this entry (default easeInOut). Not `easing`.

interpolation_overrides.description: Per-property easing, e.g. {"opacity":"linear"}; keys must be in this entry.

path.description: Stroke (draw) only: its shape at this time, [[x, y], ...] canvas px; morphs between keys by arc length.

positionX.description: Canvas px (not `x`); same origin as the item's x.

positionY.description: Canvas px (not `y`); same origin as the item's y. Text sent with y + y_anchor: means the anchored point too (track shifted to match; see keyframes_shifted).

timestamp.description: Clip seconds, ≥0 (0 = the clip's first frame)

width.description: px (0 ok: a bar drawing in)

keyframes.description: Entries as in add_elements (units, ≥0 clip seconds). Each property named in your entries has its WHOLE track replaced; tracks you don't name are kept. null or [] clears ALL keyframes. Props per element_type: get_element_schema.

keyframes_repeat.description: Repeat `keyframes` as a cycle; needs `keyframes` on the same item.

count.description: Total cycles, including the one written (1 = no-op). Stops at clip end; over 600 generated keyframes → error.

every.description: Seconds between cycle starts (default: the cycle's span). Larger → holds the last value in the gap (a pulse every 2s). Shorter than the cycle → rejected.

mode.description: 'loop' (default): replays forwards; seamless only if first and last values match. 'pingpong': alternates direction, returns to start without a jump (pulse/breathe from a one-way ramp).

param_tracks.description: Animation elements only: same as type_data.param_tracks (send in one place).

parent_id.description: As get_clip reports it (group id, or clip id when ungrouped), so a read round-trips: the current parent is a no-op. Another named group's id on this clip moves it there; clip id or null → root. Prefer `group`; it wins if both are sent.

save_as_component.description: Animation elements only. true (auto-named) or a name: save as a reusable component after this item's updates land; returns component_id. An HTML animation saves its page and current parameter values.

type_data.description: Type-specific updates (needs element_type); fields: get_element_schema mode 'update'.

width.description: px (0 ok). Text: the wrap width (re-wraps).

x.description: Canvas px. `x` is the left edge, except TEXT where alignment picks it: left→left, center→centre, right→right. Changing alignment in the same call re-anchors x to the new edge.

y.description: Canvas px; for TEXT `y` is the vertical CENTRE when centre-aligned and the TOP otherwise; every other type uses the top. Text: always with y_anchor.

y_anchor.description: TEXT only. ALWAYS send `y_anchor` ('top'|'center'|'bottom') with `y` on text; without it y inherits the alignment origin. To centre in a row, pill, chip, card or button: `y` = the container's centre line + y_anchor:'center'; the server centres the MEASURED box (wrapping and `fit` change its height, so don't compute it). Without `y`: anchors to the CURRENT box (keeps a centred label centred across a re-measure). Not stored: resend every call. (Also accepted in type_data; this wins.)

name: update_elements
title: Update elements
